result.summary: The page is largely well-designed and visually consistent. The only notable defect is the missing icon/label for the 'Orders' tab in the bottom navigation, which appears as an empty gap between 'Search' and 'Profile'. The partially visible carousel item on the right and the card cut off at the bottom are expected scroll behaviors and not counted as defects.

issues.description: The 'Orders' tab in the bottom navigation bar has no icon above its label, unlike the other tabs (Home, Search, Profile) which all show icons. This leaves an empty gap and breaks the visual consistency of the tab bar.
issues.suggestion: Add an appropriate icon (e.g., a receipt or bag icon) above the 'Orders' label, matching the size, weight, and color states (active/inactive) of the other tab icons.

issues.description: The notification bell icon in the top-right has a small red indicator dot but no visible badge count or text alternative, which may make it unclear to users that there is an unread notification.
issues.suggestion: Provide an accessible label (e.g., 'Notifications, 1 unread') and consider a count badge so the notification state is clear to all users, including screen-reader users.
